rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a favorable or timely opportunity.

example.english: This trip gave me an occasion to meet my idol.
example.traditional: 呢次旅行畀咗我一個機會見偶像。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 bei2 zo2 ngo5 jat1 go3 gei1 wui6 gin3 ngau5 zoeng6

rows.note: Use this for a particular time when something happened or a particular instance, as in 今次 or 嗰次.

example.english: I was really scared on that occasion.
example.jyutping: go2 ci3 ngo5 zan1 hai6 haak3 can1

rows.note: Use this for a special event, function, or social setting rather than for an ordinary occurrence.

example.english: This occasion isn't suitable for telling jokes like that.
example.traditional: 呢個場合唔適合講呢啲笑話。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 coeng4 hap6 m4 sik1 hap6 gong2 ni1 di1 siu3 waa6

rows.note: Use this when occasion means a reason or motive for a reaction or action.

example.english: They have no occasion to be so angry.
example.jyutping: keoi5 mou5 lei5 jau4 gam3 nau1 wo3
